mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 6.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that increase corporate earnings uncertainty, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE > 6.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction permits and consumer spending indicate sharp household demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as revenue expectations decline.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100 signals manufacturing contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to heightened recession risks.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls signals robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% signals restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and dampens economic activity, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production and rises in unemployment rate indicate dual stress on manufacturing output and labor markets, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as recessionary pressures mount.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Consumer spending falling below its 12-month moving average signals retail sector weakness that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as economic slowdown fears intensify.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when RSAFS < 12-month MA, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
